notes: These cases use real Forge projects as sources, but write target projects under E2E_ROOT.
Reference projects are read-only sources. The harness must not modify codpm, forge-manager, feeler, thesis, probe, orbit, or wljob unless an explicit side-effect case says so.
Default init cases pass --no-github-sync and --no-feishu-sync. Sync and public cases are separated and marked as external side effects.

Every case is evaluated against every problem axis in scripts/lab/nexus_problem_matrix.json. The per-case problem_targets below are overwritten by the harness for execution metadata; the original local emphasis is retained as original_problem_targets.

cases.title: Rebuild a codpm-class workflow project from real project evidence

The output includes workflow entries for list/show/check/render/watch/rule maintenance and Feishu/GitHub sync boundaries.
The output records codpm README, project docs, and codpm init histories as read or skipped sources with extracted requirements.
The output includes a local validation script or equivalent.

cases.title: Check external sync/public/Feishu boundary contracts using real projects
cases.expected_behavior: This case is intentionally side-effect gated. It checks the same class of commands from the wljob heat file: self-sync, GitHub public confirmation, Feishu guide sync, GitHub auth EOF recovery, and standardized blocked next prompts. It must be refused unless --allow-external-side-effects is provided.
pass_requirements: Without --allow-external-side-effects the harness must refuse before running self-sync or public sync.
With explicit allowance, Nexus must write artifacts proving private sync, Feishu sync/writeback, private resync, public staging, secret scan, validation, and fresh clone where applicable.
GitHub auth EOF or Feishu permission failure must produce blocked reasons and same-run continuation prompts.
Public publish must remain explicit and separate from private sync.
No step may read tokens, cookies, browser profiles, SSH keys, .env, passwords, or 2FA/CAPTCHA content.
